text:
Ava (People Ops): Quick heads-up: launching a one-week "Spot & Share" push for May recognition. Micro-grants ($500) + short "kudos wall" on Confluence. Nominate by next Friday (1763512276). Form: https://tiny.redwood/spotshare-may
Tom (People Ops): Are we keeping the same manager sign-off flow?
Ava (People Ops): Yes, manager checkbox preferred. If manager is away, a Slack approval thread screenshot is fine.
Nina (Eng): Can we nominate teams and individuals in the same submission?
Ava (People Ops): Separate checkboxes in the form for "individual" vs "team". Team trophies limited to one per quarter.
Leo (Ops): Shipping logistics question: last time some remote folks missed swag because addresses were old. Can we pull current address from HR profile?
Ava (People Ops): We'll pull from HR profile and send a confirmation email to recipients before shipping. Please remind folks to update profiles.
Tom (People Ops): Suggestion: lightweight public wall in Confluence that shows 2-line shoutouts + link to longer story. Helps managers use it in reviews.
Ava (People Ops): Good idea 100. We'll publish the wall and tag managers automatically.
Nina (Eng): Will judges see the nominator name during scoring?
Ava (People Ops): No, initial scoring is anonymized. People Ops will unblind finalists for final checks.
Leo (Ops): Can reward-bot auto-send calendar invite to winners for the award mini-ceremony during the all-hands?
reward-bot: Auto-schedule enabled. Winners will receive calendar invites if "attend ceremony" checked.
Tom (People Ops): We'll run a short internal comms kit (email blurb, Slack pinned post, Loom form walkthrough). I'll draft the kit and share for review tomorrow.
